summary: Lead provenance is attributable to CQC data sources. Every provider/lead originates from the audited CQC pipeline (extract → clean → quality audit → prepare → import). The pipeline creates immutable snapshots with checksums. The quality_report.json provides per-field completeness. The data-status page (/data-status) shows source freshness. /api/v1/version returns the exact deployed Git SHA for reproducibility. The incremental_update.py handles ongoing data updates with provenance tracking.
assertions: CQC pipeline: immutable snapshot → deterministic shards → watermark advance
/api/v1/version returns deployed Git SHA for exact reproducibility
Incremental update pipeline with provenance tracking
